title: Made a level-based puzzle game to learn principles of Conway's Game of Life
author: Donkeytonk
selftext:
My friend who's a Bio Engineering researcher at UCL sent me a link to [conway's game of life](https://playgameoflife.com/). I struggled with it so I made a little level-based puzzle game that teaches Celluar Autonoma step-by-step. I'm building an AI for making touch based games so it was a good little test to see how well it turns an open ended sandbox educational tool into a more structured game. 

I think it came out well, took about 30 minutes to make (works on mobile and web) -
